serve_static_files: serve static files from a document root directory with optional manifest asset fallback
serve_manifest_assets: serve static files with manifest-based asset resolution for versioned filenames
serve_ranged_responses: serve static files with HTTP range request support via RangedFileResponse
serve_cache_controlled: serve static files with If-Modified-Since and Last-Modified cache headers
serve_django_urlconf: configure a Django URL pattern to serve static files from a document root path
